files.decision.md: Narrow clearance and wide clearance both reached 5 of 6 goals in training. Wide clearance touched one post versus three. Contact count was the predeclared tie-break. We froze wide clearance. Held-out evaluation reached 4/6. Missing one post could reflect a noisy mask or map fusion; we did not isolate them.
